problem_statement: A floating F5 profile does not identify the appliance build or its name producer. Routing an opaque hosted source word through a Tcl 8.4 compatibility recipe or reporting String can collapse source inputs and fabricate runtime lookup authority.
question: How do hosted F5 source names retain their actual context and original input without borrowing native Tcl/Jim execution rules?
conclusion: Vendor source inputs retain the complete original word, source channel, full lexer configuration, actual lexical command site and independently selected hosted authoring context. The exact measured TMM variable projection is a separate observed authority and is available only for its recorded operand purpose. Unsupported opaque, escaped or computed materialisation remains owned and unavailable; it does not reopen reporting-string advice or select a C/Jim recipe. Source cards, Registry operand roles, byte publication, storage, compiler locals, Normal completion and edits require their own consumers.
scope: Implementation contract for explicitly authored TMM, tmsh, iApp implementation and iCall contexts. Registered environments select only their own context; iCall can be supplied explicitly. APL and unmeasured presentation callbacks do not inherit implementation Tcl. Plain ASCII literal source units are the narrow implemented advice projection; numeric escapes, Unicode and counted raw-zero materialisation are not guessed. Exact observed BIG-IP build/event variable addressing remains bounded by its independent existing policy. No native execution or appliance reconfirmation is asserted.

tests.assertion: Authoring context cannot issue observed storage; explicit observed unqualified counted addressing remains independent and no Native projection is supplied.
Actual hosted words retain context and whole-source correspondence, escaped opaque names remain owned/unavailable, and vendor advice does not issue runtime variable symbols.
An explicitly retained iCall context survives authentic source input without rewriting the actual supplied parser configuration or attesting an appliance build.

Selected hosted procedure bodies retain complete ParamList ownership, supported original formal child ordinals and source extents, local receiver form and opaque unavailable names independently of UI variable maps and runtime cell symbols.

Selected event and authentic root source advice remain different lexical homes; RULE_INIT static advice grants no runtime domain, qualified completion abstains, and unsupported ParamList stays owned without invented children.
Body, formal and written advice retain the complete actual keyed availability context and Registry generation; mismatched hosted contexts and foreign role owners cannot donate source advice.
